Decide by Schmid nilpotent-orbit and SL2-orbit asymptotics whether N!=0, N^2=0 of rank two, W=W(N)[2] has dim Gr^W_1=2 identified with H^1(E), dim Gr^W_2=18, dim Gr^W_3=2, and the Carlson extension class of W1 by Gr^W_2 and of Gr^W_2 by Gr^W_3 for this named (F1,F2,G) is nonsplit and recovers the modulus of E.
